text: Mutts quiet, sandwiches home. Go get your garage back, kid. And mine. I never had one, but go get it anyway.
The chewing has STOPPED. First silence in six years. Here — 80 bolts, and take my respect too, it's free.
New neighbor! Quick favor: the Scrap Mutts ate my mailbox, my spare legs, and my optimism. Thin the pack — four should send a message.
The message being ANYTHING. I'm not picky. 80 bolts in it for you.
Still hearing chewing at night. Keep swinging, kid.
Second thing. When the repo drones took your garage, the blast scattered my emergency sandwich stash. THREE sandwiches. Still vacuum-sealed. Still legally food.
EMERGENCY sandwiches. 100 bolts. The mustard packet stays with me.
I can smell that you haven't found them all. It's a gift. And a curse.
All three! Barely dented! You're a good kid. Here's 100 bolts and a life lesson: always know where your sandwich is.
